svg.text: Outcome bias & hindsight - vi sao 5 note dau deu UNPROVEN
Timeline tien trien quy trinh ghi chu, 07-01 -> 07-17
Thoi gian viet note (2026-07-01 -> 2026-07-17)
Batch A (07-01->07-07): 5/5 UNPROVEN
Khong entry_type/confluence_score/first_error_step
Batch B-D (07-08->07-15): field day hon
Nhung van thieu tach biet truoc/sau outcome
Batch E (07-16->07-17): tu sua loi so
Van UNPROVEN ve outcome, nhung quy trinh tot hon
Vi sao la HINDSIGHT, khong chi la thieu du lieu
1. Note viet SAU khi outcome da xay ra (backtest
replay, khong phai live read).
2. Cau danh gia (vd "thang vi cho du dieu kien")
viet trong phan replay, khong tach biet duoc
voi phan "se lam gi tai thoi diem entry thuc".
3. Khong co timestamp/annotation nao chung minh
ket luan duoc rut ra TRUOC khi biet TP/SL hit.
-> Khong the phan biet "read dung" khoi "read
duoc viet lai de khop voi ket qua da biet".
Quy trinh de xuat: ghi tai hard right edge
1. Ghi bias/draw/sweep/displacement/POI/entry
TRUOC khi xem nen sau diem quyet dinh.
2. Chup/luu trang thai chart tai dung nen quyet
dinh (khong phai chart da keo dai ve sau).
3. Tach rieng section "Du doan tai right edge"
va section "Replay sau khi biet outcome" -
khong hoa tron 2 section.
-> Cho phep phan biet duoc process tot voi
process duoc viet lai de trong dep hon.
Ket luan cap batch (batchA.md Pattern #1, #2)
"UNPROVEN dong loat o ca 5 note batch A - khong note nao co bang chung tach biet thoi diem ghi
chu truoc/sau khi biet ket qua." Day khong phai loi cua tung note rieng le - la dac diem CO CAU
TRUC cua backtest replay khi khong co quy trinh ghi chu tach biet duoc dung truoc.
5/17 Win (~30% so lenh Win) mang rui ro nay - khong the loai khoi WR, chi co the ghi nhan ro rui ro.
